In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of automatically generating a query signature from a document and using the query signature to retrieve documents that are similar to the document in a search engine.
the design, analysis, implementation, and experimental evaluation of a novel and efficient approach for near-duplicate detection in a large corpus of web documents.
the problem of automatic retrieval of similar content from a search engine using only its query interface.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our methods are able to find near duplicates of the input document with high precision and recall in most of our experiments.
we have developed an approach that is robust, scalable and effective in finding near-duplicate content using search engine queries.
the methods presented in this thesis can be used to automatically retrieve similar content in large search engine corpora using a query interface and are robust against performance variations.

we have developed a scalable and effective approach to solve the problem of coverage testing using a query interface.
we can find near-duplicates of documents in the web with high recall and precision.
these methods can be used to perform effective coverage testing for search engines.

the search engine query interface can be used to solve coverage testing problems with high accuracy.
